name: claudestra
description: Orchestrate long-lived Claude Code sessions as a staff, with a chain of command: checks for the claudestra CLI (or installs it, if allowed), keeps its guard in place, and ships its skills.

source.title: Install source
source.description: Where uv installs claudestra from; empty for this plugin's own release on GitHub. A git URL without a version, such as git+ssh://git@github.com/adityaruplaha/claudestra.git, is pinned to this plugin's version. A local checkout's path is for developing claudestra, and is installed editable.

auto_install.title: Install claudestra automatically
auto_install.description: Off: when a session starts, the plugin checks that the claudestra it pins is installed, and if not, says the command that installs it. On: it runs that command itself, with uv tool install.
